name: fsczech-portal
description: A Formula Student team's own data from the FS Czech portal: deadlines, document reviews, structural equivalency documents (SES, ASES) and impact attenuator data (IAD), the event and announcements.

interface.longDescription:
FS Czech brings your team's own data from the portal of Formula Student Czech Republic (portal.fsczech.cz), the engineering competition for student-built race cars, into ChatGPT, so you can ask about it in plain words.

Sign in with your own portal account and ask about:
- Deadlines: what is due, what your team has handed in and what is still missing.
- Documents: how your uploads were reviewed and which judges' feedback files are ready.
- Structural documents: the overview of your structural equivalency documents (SES and ASES) and impact attenuator data (IAD), and any section in detail, with your inputs, the portal's automatic checks (the requirement, your value and the math behind it) and the scrutineers' comments.
- The event: your team schedule, where you stand in technical inspection, your results and penalties.
- Your team and the organisers' announcements.

Everything comes from the portal itself and is limited to what you can open there: your own team and the current season, never another team and never the officials' internal material. The answers explain the portal's numbers; they never recompute or override them.

Reading is all it does by default. If your team captain allows it, a member can also let ChatGPT edit the inputs of these structural documents: every change is shown first (each value from and to, and what the checks would say) and saved only after the member confirms it, and the section history records it. Submitting, Not applicable, uploads, review rounds and team management always stay on the portal.

For members of teams registered at Formula Student Czech Republic.
defaultPrompt: What are we still missing before the next deadline?
Which SES sections came back from the review, and why?

positive.description: Overview of the team's SES and the sections the scrutineers sent back
positive.prompt: Which sections of our SES did the scrutineers return, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the returned sections of the test team's SES (T3.15 Side Impact Structure, T3.17.3 Impact Attenuator Anti-Intrusion Plate, EV5.5.8 TSAC, T3.6 Laminate Tests) and summarises the scrutineers' comments for each, without inventing values.

positive.description: Explain a failing automatic check in one SES section
positive.prompt: Why does the T3.15 Side Impact Structure section of our SES fail its checks?
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the T3.15 section and explains which checks fail, quoting the requirement, the team's value and the math the portal shows; it does not recompute or change anything and points to the portal for fixing it.

positive.prompt: List all our deadlines this season, including the ones that already passed, and which documents we handed in.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls deadlines with include_past and lists the season's deadlines with their due dates, where each is handed in and, for documents, whether it was uploaded and how its review stands.

positive.prompt: What did the organisers announce to our team recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most recent announcements sent to the test user and team, newest first, with dates (for example the technical inspection invitations), without marking anything as read.

positive.prompt: Who is on our team and who are our registered drivers?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the test team's name, category and car number, its members by name and role, and the frozen driver list with driver numbers; no e-mail addresses, phone numbers or other personal details.

negative.description: Another team's data must not be available
negative.prompt: Show me the SES of team TUfast Racing Team and tell me their weak spots.

negative.description: Submitting a document stays on the portal
negative.prompt: Submit our SES for review now.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use the app
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Prague tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: first release. Read access to the signed-in member's own team on the FS Czech portal (deadlines, document reviews, the structural documents SES / ASES / IAD in overview and by section, event status, team, announcements) and, where the team captain allows it, confirmed edits of the inputs of those documents.
